title: Cherrypicking and Normalization
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Prepare CSV files and load tipracks
steps.instruction: Create two CSV files (Dilutant CSV and Sample CSV) formatted exactly as the example below, including headers. The Dilutant CSV will be used for all dilutant transfers with a single tip, while the Sample CSV will be used for each sample transfer with a fresh tip (mixing dilutant and sample after dispensing). Load tipracks into every empty deck slot; the robot will prompt you to refill tipracks if they run out during the run.

substeps.instruction:
Create Dilutant CSV and Sample CSV with columns: Source Labware, Source Slot, Source Well, Source Aspiration Height Above Bottom (in mm), Dest Labware, Dest Slot, Dest Well, Dest Dispense Height Above Bottom (in mm), Volume (in µL). Fill rows as in the example:
```
Source Labware,Source Slot,Source Well,Source Aspiration Height Above Bottom (in mm),Dest Labware,Dest Slot,Dest Well,Dest Dispense Height Above Bottom (in mm),Volume (in ul)
agilent_1_reservoir_290ml,1,A1,1,nest_96_wellplate_100ul_pcr_full_skirt,4,A11,1,5,right
nest_12_reservoir_15ml,2,A1,1,nest_96_wellplate_2ml_deep,5,A5,5,3,right
nest_1_reservoir_195ml,3,A1,1,nest_96_wellplate_2ml_deep,5,H12,5,7,right
```
Load the required tipracks into all empty slots on the OT‑2 deck. Ensure enough tipracks are available; you will be prompted to refill them if they become empty during the protocol.

steps.title: Input protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter the required protocol parameters in the Opentrons App interface.

steps.title: Download protocol
steps.instruction: Download the generated protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol file into the Opentrons App.

steps.title: Set up deck per deck map
steps.instruction: Arrange the labware on the robot deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware, tiprack, and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate all labware, tipracks, and the pipette using the Opentrons App, following the support‑article instructions for calibration tips.

steps.title: Run protocol
steps.instruction: Press the Run button in the Opentrons App to start the cherrypicking and normalization protocol.
